caption:
Factored form shows the x-intercepts instantly.

y = 3(x − 2)(x + 6) crosses at x = 2 and x = −6. Set each factor to zero and the signs flip.

Send this to a friend who's studying for the SAT.
tiktok_caption: Factored form shows the x-intercepts instantly: y = 3(x − 2)(x + 6) crosses at 2 and −6.

youtube.title: Factored Form: Read the X-Intercepts Instantly
youtube.description: Factored form isn't on the SAT reference sheet. Worked example: y = 3(x − 2)(x + 6) has x-intercepts 2 and −6 and axis of symmetry x = −2.
